summary.text: Christina Baisden is the Democratic candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 44, in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging incumbent Republican Carl Roop.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a mother, spouse, blue-collar worker and community advocate.

paragraphs.text: Christina Baisden said in a Ballotpedia survey that she has a record of defending civil rights, demanding transparency in government and fighting utility rate increases.

She listed her key messages as saving public education from collapse and putting limits on the Hope Scholarship, capping utility rates, and protecting working families, the elderly and the most vulnerable.
She named Education West Virginia and West Virginia Can't Wait as endorsers.
